about: What Auto should make of a text typed or pasted in the box (lib/Intent.psm1 Get-Intent, mode auto). Invented texts, English and Dutch. want: ask | add | unclear | meetings (a request for the Teams meetings of some days, 2026-11-20). tests/Intent.Tests.ps1 runs every one; a wrong call the operator reports becomes a new line here (2026-11-18).
